description.value: A Taco Bell fast-food location on Lougheed Highway in Coquitlam, offering Tex-Mex staples including tacos, burritos, and a dedicated Veggie Cravings Menu with vegetarian options. The restaurant features both dine-in seating and a drive-thru, as well as online ordering and delivery. It sits along a major arterial corridor making it a convenient calorie stop for cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities area.
